59975-the-impostor-a-tale-of-old-annapol.title: The Impostor A Tale Of Old Annapolis
59975-the-impostor-a-tale-of-old-annapol.creator: John Reed Scott
59975-the-impostor-a-tale-of-old-annapol.description: A book by John Reed Scott. A fascinating story, the scenes of which are laid in England at the time of Richard the Third. The heroine, the Countess of Clare, is a beautiful and charming lady of the court, a protégée of the queen.

arxiv-1601-01931.title: Radial parts of Haar measures
arxiv-1601-01931.creator: and probability distributions on the space
arxiv-1601-01931.description: Abstract Consider the space \mathcal{C} of conjugacy classes of a unitary group \mathrm{U}(n+m) with respect to a smaller unitary group \mathrm{U}(m) . It is known that for any element of the space \mathcal{C} we can assign canonically a matrix-valued rational function on the Riemann sphere (a Livshits characteristic function).

arxiv-1612-00473.title: Charmed mesons at finite temperature and chemical potential
arxiv-1612-00473.creator: Fernando E. Serna \fnsep, Gastão Krein \fnsep
arxiv-1612-00473.description: Abstract We compute the masses of the pseudoscalar mesons π + \pi^{+} , K 0 K^{0} and D + D^{+} at finite temperature and baryon chemical potential. The computations are based on a symmetry-preserving Dyson-Schwinger equation treatment of a vector-vector four quark contact interaction.

arxiv-1902-04451.title: Mixture of two unequally charged superfluids in a magnetic field
arxiv-1902-04451.creator: S. Seyyare Aksu, A. Levent Subaşı, Nader Ghazanfari
arxiv-1902-04451.description: Abstract The artificial magnetic fields engineered for ultra cold gases depend on the internal structure of the neutral atoms. Therefore the components of a mixture composed of two atomic gases can exhibit a different response to an artificial magnetic field. Such a mixture can be interpreted as a mixture of two atomic gases, carrying different synthetic charges.

arxiv-2102-02139.title: Riemann surfaces of second kind and effective finiteness theorems
arxiv-2102-02139.creator: Burglind Jöricke
arxiv-2102-02139.description: Abstract . The Geometric Shafarevich Conjecture and the Theorem of de Franchis state the finiteness of the number of certain holomorphic objects on closed or punctured Riemann surfaces. The analog of these kind of theorems for Riemann surfaces of second kind is an estimate of the number of irreducible holomorphic objects up to homotopy (or isotopy, respectively).

arxiv-2108-12459.title: From Pivots to Graphs: Augmented Cycle Density as a Generalization to One Time Inverse Consultation Thanks: Extension to work done under the guidance of Dr. Jorge Gracia and Dr. Mikel L. Forcada. Supported by Apertium through the Google Summer of Code Program
arxiv-2108-12459.creator: Shashwat Goel, Kunwar Shaanjeet Singh Grover
arxiv-2108-12459.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shashwat Goel, Kunwar Shaanjeet Singh Grover. This paper describes an approach used to generate new translations using raw bilingual dictionaries as part of the 4 t ​ h 4^{th} Task Inference Across Dictionaries (TIAD 2021) shared task. We propose Augmented Cycle Density (ACD) as a framework that combines insights from two state of the art methods that require no sense information and parallel corpora: Cycle Density (CD) and One Time Inverse Consultation (OTIC).

arxiv-2111-11849.title: Nicolò Masi
arxiv-2111-11849.creator: INFN & Alma Mater Studiorum - Bologna University,
arxiv-2111-11849.description: Abstract In this article I propose a new criterion to extend the Standard Model of particle physics from a straightforward algebraic conjecture: the symmetries of physical microscopic forces originate from the automorphism groups of main Cayley–Dickson algebras, from complex numbers to octonions and sedenions.

arxiv-2302-11304.title: The Carnegie Supernova Project I. Spectroscopic analysis of stripped-envelope supernovae
arxiv-2302-11304.creator: S. Holmbo, M. D. Stritzinger, E. Karamehmetoglu, C. R. Burns, N. Morrell, C. Ashall, E. Y. Hsiao, L. Galbany, G. Folatelli, M. M. Phillips, E. Baron, C. P. Gutiérrez, G. Leloudas, T. E. Müller-Bravo, P. Hoeflich, F. Taddia, N. B. Suntzeff
arxiv-2302-11304.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by S. Holmbo, M. D. Stritzinger, E. Karamehmetoglu, C. R. Burns, N. Morrell, C. Ashall, E. Y. Hsiao, L. Galbany, G. Folatelli, M. M. Phillips, E. Baron, C. P. Gutiérrez, G. Leloudas, T. E. Müller-Bravo, P. Hoeflich, F. Taddia, N. B. Suntzeff. An analysis leveraging 170 optical spectra of 35 stripped-envelope (SE) core-collapse supernovae (SNe) observed by the Carnegie Supernova Project I and published in a companion paper is presented.

arxiv-2312-02376.title: Fast Fourier Transform periodic interpolation method for superposition sums in a periodic unit cell
arxiv-2312-02376.creator: Fangzhou Ai, Vitaliy Lomakin
arxiv-2312-02376.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fangzhou Ai, Vitaliy Lomakin. We propose a Fast Fourier Transform based Periodic Interpolation Method (FFT-PIM), a flexible and computationally efficient approach for computing the scalar potential given by a superposition sum in a unit cell of an infinitely periodic array. Under the same umbrella, FFT-PIM allows computing the potential for 1D, 2D, and 3D periodicities for dynamic problems involving the Helmholtz potential and static problems involving Coulomb potential, including problems with and without a periodic phase shift.

arxiv-2505-11675.title: Bayesian Optimization of Pythia8 Tunes
arxiv-2505-11675.creator: Ali Al Kadhim, Harrison B Prosper, Stephen Mrenna
arxiv-2505-11675.description: Abstract A new tune (set of model parameters) is found for the six most important parameters of the Pythia8 final state parton shower and hadronization model using Bayesian optimization. The tune fits the LEPI data from ALEPH better than the default tune in Pythia8 .

arxiv-2509-17439.title: SPICED: A Synaptic Homeostasis-Inspired Framework for Unsupervised Continual EEG Decoding
arxiv-2509-17439.creator: Yangxuan Zhou, Sha Zhao, Jiquan Wang, Haiteng Jiang, Shijian Li,, Tao Li, Gang Pan
arxiv-2509-17439.description: Abstract Human brain achieves dynamic stability-plasticity balance through synaptic homeostasis, a self-regulatory mechanism that stabilizes critical memory traces while preserving optimal learning capacities. Inspired by this biological principle, we propose SPICED: a neuromorphic framework that integrates the synaptic homeostasis mechanism for unsupervised continual EEG decoding, particularly addressing practical scenarios where new individuals with inter-individual variability emerge continually.

arxiv-2605-04209.title: Undetectable Backdoors in Model Parameters: Hiding Sparse Secrets in High Dimensions
arxiv-2605-04209.creator: Sarthak Choudhary, Atharv Singh Patlan, Nils Palumbo, Ashish Hooda, Kassem Fawaz, Somesh Jha, [0.5em] University of Wisconsin--Madison

britannica-1911-fellow.title: Fellow (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-fellow.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-fellow.description: Article 'Fellow' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. a companion, comrade or mate, as in “fellow-man,” “fellow-countryman,” &c. The word from the 15th century has also been applied, generally and colloquially, to any male person, often in a contemptuous or pitying sense. The Old English féolage meant a partner in a business, i.e. one who lays (lag) money or property (féoh, fee) together for a common purpose.

pmc-10560672.title: Maximizing electrical output and reducing heat-related losses in photovoltaic thermal systems with a thorough examination of flow channel integration and nanofluid cooling
pmc-10560672.creator: F. M. Allehiany, Abid A. Memon, M. Asif Memon, Amsalu Fenta
pmc-10560672.description: In recent years, global energy demand has surged, emphasizing the need for nations to enhance energy resources. The photovoltaic thermal (PV/T) system, capable of generating electrical energy from sunlight, is a promising renewable energy solution. However, it faces the challenge of overheating, which reduces efficiency.

pmc-10655462.title: Estimating mortality in rare diseases using a population-based registry, 2002 through 2019
pmc-10655462.creator: Monica Mazzucato, Laura Visonà Dalla Pozza, Cinzia Minichiello, Ema Toto, Andrea Vianello, Paola Facchin
pmc-10655462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundRare diseases (RD) are a heterogeneous group of diseases, sharing aspects of complexity. Prognosis is variable, even in individuals with the same disease. Real-world data on RD as a whole are scarce.

pmc-11382019.title: Neurosensory retina detachment combined with retinal pigment epithelium separation from the choroid in the course of dry macular degeneration – A case report
pmc-11382019.creator: Maciej Gawęcki, Andrzej Grzybowski
pmc-11382019.description: Introductionof advanced diagnostic methods shed the light on the variable course of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Despite establishing AMD classifications used in clinical practice, there are still forms of AMD that do not fit into these systems. The case report presents a rare evolution of non-neovascular form of AMD presenting at baseline as large soft drusen.

pmc-11545492.title: Does Hand-Predominance Have a Predominant Influence on Craniofacial Asymmetric and Anthropometric Analysis in Preadolescences?
pmc-11545492.creator: Gloria Chen, Junior Chun-Yu Tu, Shih-Heng Chen, Emma Yuh-Jia Hsieh, Betty C J Pai, Ching-Yen Tsai, Pang-Yun Chou, Antonio Ferreras
pmc-11545492.description: Background: Although the human body generally exhibits bilateral symmetry, achieving perfect symmetry is exceedingly uncommon. During preadolescent development, a face that approximates symmetry is considered both aesthetically and functionally ideal. This study aimed to investigate the relationship between craniofacial traits and hand predominance, using three-dimensional (3D) stereophotogrammetry to discern whether facial soft-tissue characteristics are correlated with hand preference.

pmc-12643548.title: Racial and ethnic differences in treatment and survival for hepatocellular carcinoma patients undergoing systemic therapy
pmc-12643548.creator: Kelsey S Lau-Min, Angela C Tramontano, Franklin Iheanacho, Thomas Adam Abrams, Christopher R Manz
pmc-12643548.description: BackgroundThere are substantial historical racial and ethnic differences in treatment survival for patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) that may have changed with approval of 9 novel systemic HCC therapies between 2017 and 2022.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study included patients from the Flatiron Health Research Database who received systemic therapy between 2011 and 2023.

pmc-12673886.title: Efficacy of acupuncture for motor dysfunction in early Parkinson’s disease: protocol for a randomized, single-blind, sham-controlled clinical trial
pmc-12673886.creator: Qifu Li, Yuquan Shen, Yangyang Wang, Junxia Liu, Ziwen Chen, Weiming Luo, Yan Chen, Yunnan Liu, Xinghua Zhu, Simin Xue, Yanru Chen, Dehua Li, Taipin Guo, Jun Zhou, Fanrong Liang
pmc-12673886.description: IntroductionMotor dysfunction, including bradykinesia, rigidity, tremor, and gait disturbance, is the core clinical feature of Parkinson’s disease (PD) and a major cause of disability. In early-stage PD (Hoehn and Yahr ≤2.5), neurodegeneration is relatively mild, and timely intervention may help preserve motor function and delay progression.

pmc-12979324.title: The right eye for fixations: Eye asymmetries modulate gaze patterns towards speakers
pmc-12979324.creator: Desiderio Cano Porras, Max M. Louwerse
pmc-12979324.description: Eye contact is critical in face-to-face social interactions. Prior research has shown that dialog partners primarily focus on the eyes of the speaker both when the speaker is speaking and, particularly, when the speaker is not. These findings are compatible with the communicative but specifically the social function of eye contact.

pmc-13264205.title: Refined single-cell profiling captures a CCR5high CD4+ cytotoxic T-cell precursor in multiple sclerosis
pmc-13264205.creator: Fabiënne van Puijfelik, Jasper Rip, Yifan van Hasselt, Annet F. Wierenga-Wolf, Sophie Shyfrin, Anna C. Pelser, Marie-Jose Melief, Romy A.M. Klein Kranenbarg, Eric M. Bindels, Harmen J.G. van de Werken, Chaja M.J. van Ansenwoude, Helga E. de Vries, Willem A. Dik, Janet de Beukelaar, Ide Smets, Beatri
pmc-13264205.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryBackgroundDecades of immunological and genetic studies highlight CD4+ T cells as initiators of central nervous system (CNS) pathology in individuals who develop multiple sclerosis (MS). A low-frequency CD4+ T-cell population termed T helper 17.1 (Th17.1) has been argued to play a central role during MS onset due to differences in abundance, yet little is known about their functional heterogeneity and distinctive mode of action in MS.MethodsFeatures that distinguished Th17.1 from Th17 and Th1 cells in the blood were explored using spectral flow

pmc-13469891.title: Maternal-fetal interface abnormalities in unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss: mechanisms, models, and a framework for subtype identification
pmc-13469891.creator: Asahi Tokuoka, Kiriko Iida, Mitsutoshi Yamada, Masanori Ono, Naoko Irie

pmc-13544651.title: Red Blood Cell Parameters as Cost-effective Biomarkers in Normal and Altered Glycemic States: A Cross-sectional Study
pmc-13544651.creator: Priyadarsini Dhavakumar, Latha Ramalingam, Vanathy Karunamoorthy
pmc-13544651.description: Background:Hemoglobin A1C levels, along with fasting and postprandial blood glucose levels, are the tests routinely used in the diagnosis and management of diabetes. Complete blood count (CBC) is a simple blood test commonly done for various conditions, from which various red blood cell (RBC) parameters can be assessed.

pmc-13615779.title: Tougher leaves under global urbanization
pmc-13615779.creator: Yiyong Li, Jianan Wang, Zhuxuan Tan, Longfei Li, Zihao Man, Cheng Zhang, Hui Liu
pmc-13615779.description: Urban environments expose resident organisms to intense, multifaceted selective pressures. Studies employing intraspecific responses of functional traits have proven particularly valuable for understanding vegetation ecological strategy under urbanization. Here, we compiled a dataset of ten leaf functional traits of 1051 observations of 322 species from 104 cities to assess the impacts of urbanization.
